text:
Ava (CS): quick heads-up — Arcadia Health wants to kick off the preview next Wed but they flagged conformance docs (SOC2 evidence + on-prem checklist) as blockers. asking if we can surface what they actually need by EOD so we don't miss the pilot window :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Priya (CSM): I spoke with their PM earlier. they want: signed DPA, redacted SOC2 report (if possible), and confirmation of private-deploy network steps. they also asked about a short runbook for rollback during the pilot.

Evan (SE): rolling checklist here. main risk is we haven't validated the on-prem package against their specific CentOS build. I can run a quick smoke deploy in our staging env tomorrow and capture any config diffs.

Diego (Solutions): can we get a partial SOC2 extract? legal-bot previously said we can provide a redacted summary + attestation letter. @legal-bot can you confirm the accepted artifact set? :eyes:

legal-bot: Approved artifacts = [redacted SOC2 AICPA cover letter, signed DPA, attestation letter from Compliance]. Full SOC2 report requires exec approval. See /policies/compliance/artifact-guidance (internal).

Ava (CS): thanks. action items: 1) @Evan run smoke deploy + list any CentOS/runtime diffs (due tomorrow 5pm PT), 2) @Diego draft rollback runbook and network steps (due EOD Tue), 3) @legal-bot prepare redacted SOC2 + attestation and confirm delivery channel (secure S3 link) by Tue. i'll send Arcadia a short timeline and confirm pilot window. sound right? :thumbsup:

Evan (SE): will run smoke deploy at 10am PT and paste logs here. if I hit package lib mismatch I'll escalate to infra.

Diego (Solutions): drafting rollback runbook now. small snippet for review:```
Rollback steps v0.1
- disable route in load-balancer
- revert model-serving container image to stable tag: redwood/serve:stable-2025-11
- flush KV cache: `redwood cache flush --force`
- notify CS and oncall
```
I'll add the network port mappings and firewall rules next.

Priya (CSM): Arcadia PM asked whether we can have a readout call the day after pilot start to capture initial qual feedback — can we reserve 30m? I'm proposing Thu 11am PT.

Ava (CS): let's do Thu 11am PT. i'll send the invite conditional on artifacts arriving. also want to flag renewal risk: they mentioned procurement constraints tied to an approved SOC2 artifact; if we slip >2w procurement may pause pilot -> higher churn risk. Marking priority high.

Evan (SE): smoke deploy finished. pasted important excerpt:```
2026-03-22T17:05:12Z INFO starting deploy
2026-03-22T17:05:18Z WARN missing libnsl.so.1 on CentOS-7 image
2026-03-22T17:05:20Z INFO fallback to static linked codec
2026-03-22T17:05:22Z INFO deploy complete, health OK
```
I patched the container to include libnsl and will push a candidate image to staging. leaving a note for infra to add libnsl to our on-prem base image.

Diego (Solutions): updated runbook with firewall ports and the on-prem precheck list. sending as a link: https://internal/arcadia/pilot-runbook (internal).

legal-bot: Redacted SOC2 package prepared. Delivery options: secure S3 link (recommended) or in-person NDA session. Confirm preferred channel and I'll generate link.

Priya (CSM): Arcadia prefers secure S3 link. i'll confirm bucket/service email and share to legal.

Ava (CS): perfect — next steps recap in thread and i'll DM Arcadia once legal confirms link. tagging owners: @Evan (SE) smoke deploy ✅, @Diego (Solutions) runbook draft ✅, @legal-bot pending link generation. we'll reconvene Tue EOD to validate artifacts and finalize Thu readout invite. anything else?

Evan (SE): nothing from me. :white_check_mark:

Diego (Solutions): adding a short checklist for pilot ops in the runbook (health metrics, token caps, throttle thresholds).

Priya (CSM): i'll prepare a 6-question feedback form to send after the Thu readout to capture quality/regression signals so we can tie back to Redwood Optimize recommendations.

Ava (CS): love it. closing loop here for now. i'll post an update if legal link goes out or if Arcadia requests schedule changes. :rocket:
